homebase.title: Strengthen your collaboration
homebase.description: Explore how you work, what you expect from each other, and what might surprise you.
homebase.experienceDescription: Estimate how each other would respond to five short work situations. Your answers stay hidden until you have both finished.
homebase.revealWaitingText: The round will complete once you have both viewed all five reveals.
homebase.unsupported: Read My Mind for teams with three founders will follow in a later step.
homebase.unsupportedTeamSize: A new Read My Mind round requires exactly two current founders.

status.active_waiting: You are done — {name} is still answering

entry.title: Read My Mind
entry.betaNotice: Read My Mind is currently in testing. Content and the experience may still change.
entry.intro: Choose a perspective for five short situations.
entry.handoffText: You answer five short situations first. Then it’s {name}’s turn. Your answers stay hidden until you have both finished.
entry.oneRoundTitle: One personal turn at a time
entry.oneRoundText: As soon as your part in the current pack is complete, you can prepare the next one — even if your co-founder has not started yet.

notification.title: {count, plural, one {One pack is waiting for {name}} other {# packs are waiting for {name}}}
notification.text: You can notify {name} now or prepare another pack first.
notification.sent: We notified {name} about the packs currently waiting.
notification.failed: The email could not be sent. The packs are still visible to {name} in the dashboard.

packs.easy_start: Start lightly and discover small things about how you work together.
packs.how_we_work: Take a closer look at how you organize decisions, ownership, and day-to-day work.
packs.when_things_get_tricky: How do you respond when pressure, feedback, or different opinions enter the picture?

transparency.independent: You first answer five short situations independently.
transparency.hidden: Your answers stay hidden until you have both completed the full round.
transparency.compare: You can then compare your perspectives together.
transparency.sharedReveal: Your answers in this round are intended for the shared reveal with your co-founder.
transparency.isolated: Private answers from Founder Alignment, Commitment Lab, or other CoFoundery areas are not used.
transparency.declinePurge: If {name} does not join this time, the round ends and the answers from this attempt are deleted.

entry.unsupported: Read My Mind for teams with three founders will follow in a later step.
entry.unsupportedTeamSize: A new Read My Mind round requires exactly two current founders.

round.introTitle: There is no right or wrong here.
round.introBodyGuess: You will probably find some situations easy to predict for {name}, while others may be harder. Simply choose what you would guess right now.
round.introBodyReveal: In the reveal, you will look together at how you understood the situations, what you expected from each other, and what you would like to talk about.
round.creatorText: Place your answers face down first.
round.creatorCompleteText: Your answers are locked in. Now it’s {name}’s turn.
round.creatorCompleteHint: Your answers stay hidden until {name} has completed their part.
round.discardHint: Only discard the round if it should no longer take place.
round.discardConfirm: Your answers from this pack will be deleted. {name} will no longer be able to answer this round.
round.discardEmailNote: {name} may already have received a notification about this round.
round.partnerWaitingText: As soon as {name} completes the first part, it’s your turn.
round.inviteTitle: {name} started Read My Mind with you
round.inviteText: Your co-founder has already completed their part. Now it’s your turn. You answer the same five situations from your perspective. Your answers stay hidden until you are finished too.
round.declineConfirm: The round will end. You can start a new one together at any time.
round.guessHint: You will see {name}'s answer later in the reveal.
round.guessHelper: Not sure yet? Just choose your best guess. This isn’t about getting it right.
round.lockWarning: After this, you cannot change your answers for this situation.
round.waitingText: Once {name} has also completed the round, you can compare your answers together.
round.readyText: Your answers are fully saved. The shared reveal will open in the next step.
round.endedText: You can start a new round later.
round.abandonConfirm: If you end the round, neither you nor {name} can continue answering or open new reveals. You can start a new round afterwards.
round.abandonFormingConfirm: If you end the round now, your answers from this attempt are deleted. You can start a new round later.

errors.changed: This round has changed. Reload the current state.
errors.locked: This answer has already been saved and can no longer be changed.

reveal.readyText: Now you can see how you assessed each other — and where something was different from what you expected.
reveal.readyNote: There are still no right answers. A difference is simply something new you now know about each other.
reveal.openHint: Only this explicit step makes the answers for this situation visible together.
reveal.needsTitle: What you need from each other
reveal.reflection: Sometimes it is enough simply to know something new about each other.
reveal.conversationMarkerTitle: Would you like to come back to this?
reveal.markConversation: I’d like to talk about this
reveal.sharedVisibility: This conversation point is visible to both of you.
reveal.markerStatusPartner: {name} would like to talk about this
reveal.conversationSummaryIntro: These are the situations you would like to look at together again.
reveal.conversationQuestion1: What stands out to you about your answers?
reveal.conversationQuestion2: In which specific work situation could this become relevant for you?
reveal.conversationQuestion3: Would you like to try something or make a clearer agreement about it?
reveal.allSeenTitle: You have viewed all five reveals
reveal.allSeenText: The round will complete once you have both viewed the reveals.
reveal.waiting: You have viewed your reveals. The round will complete once you have both finished.
reveal.completedText: You answered all situations and revealed them together.

errors.answers-incomplete: Your answers are not complete yet.
errors.changed: This round has changed in the meantime.
errors.waiting: You have viewed your reveals. The round will complete once you have both finished.
